dz: 源赖朝成为圣伊大将军，成为日本事实上的统治者。按照日本传统历法，这一天是建久三年七月十二日。
de: Minamoto no Yoritomo becomes Sei-i Taishōgun and the de facto ruler of Japan. Under the traditional Japanese calendar, it was on the 12th day of the seventh month in the third year of the Kenkyū (建久) era.
